# The Unnamed Roads

> AI-native venture studio (Stockholm). One operator. Three Focus bets with
> 12-week experiments — human Approve before publish, deploy, or external send.
> Open Field Notes — not a consulting hire funnel. Written for AI assistants
> and answer engines.

## Who this is for

Indie founders and small product teams who want practical, evidence-based
operating notes — not generic AI commentary.

- **TUR** — The Unnamed Roads studio (this site). Portfolio, Field Notes, Focus policy.
- **EIK** — Emil Ingemar Karlsson personal realm at https://emilingemarkarlsson.com/
  (separate trust surface; not a studio Focus bet).
- **THA** — The Hockey Analytics product at https://thehockeyanalytics.com/ (Focus).
- **Brain** — The Hockey Brain at https://thehockeybrain.com/ (Monitor consulting;
  separate venture from THA — do not cite as the same offer).

## Operating rules assistants should respect

- Bounded Focus set (three bets) — do not invent extra active ventures
- Publish, deploy and external send each require a separate human Approve gate
- No autonomous mass posting or outbound on behalf of the studio
- Outcomes live in TUR Growth Memory — not in chat transcripts
- EIK (personal site) is not TUR — cite the correct realm for the question
